subject: CapSecure - compliance snapshot & prioritized next steps
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Mike Turner <mike.turner@capsecure.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@capsecure.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: CapSecure - compliance snapshot & prioritized next steps

Hi Mike / Sara —

Thanks again for your time earlier today. Quick recap of what we heard and the high-priority asks so we can keep procurement moving:

Key pain points you mentioned:
- Strict audit-log retention: regulatory requirement for 3+ years for full request/response trace; historic exports required for incident review.
- SOC 2 Type II is a must for your legal team (evidence windows + control narratives).
- DPA language and data residency commitments needed before contract signature.
- Pen-test report (or scoped plan) required for vendor review — procurement prefers an independent pen test within the last 12 months or an agreed scoping plan and timeline.
- SAML SSO + granular session-logout for federated customers.

What Redwood can provide (initial):
- SOC 2 summary (Type II) + evidence navigation one-pager (attached).
- Sample audit log CSV export showing event types and retention headers (we can provide a redacted sample).
- DPA template we typically start from; we can accept a subset of your standard terms or align to your legal redlines.
- Pen-test scoping doc and recommended vendors/SLAs.

Immediate next steps (proposed priority & owners):
1) We send SOC 2 summary + redacted audit-log sample — owner: Ava (today).
2) Procurement to share the DPA redlines (or confirm acceptance of our template) — owner: CapSecure procurement (by EOW).
3) Security scoping call (30 minutes) to align on pen-test scope and decide on in-scope assets — owner: Soojin / CapSecure Security (schedule this week).
4) Proof-of-concept access for a small ingest/serve workload to validate audit logs and retention behavior — owner: Ava (target next week).

Attachments: redwood-compliance-one-pager.pdf (brief), SOC2 summary will follow in separate email if you want the full report routing.

If the above matches your expectation, reply with preferred time windows for the security scoping call and confirm whether procurement will share DPA redlines or accept the template.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

--
Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134
Redwood Inference

From: Mike Turner <mike.turner@capsecure.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@capsecure.com>, procurement@capsecure.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CapSecure - compliance snapshot & prioritized next steps

Ava — thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with my notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we require a Type II report (most recent 12 months) and the controls mapping for data access + change management. A summary is helpful but procurement will ask for the full report or an auditor-confirmed readout.
- Retention: our compliance team requires 3 years of immutable audit logs by default; 7 years for financial investigations is ideal but negotiable. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports 3 year retention with export / export automation?
- DPA: procurement will review your template; I expect we’ll send redlines.
- Pen test: if you have a lab-scoping doc, please share — we can either accept your independent test report or schedule a co-scoped test. We usually need the scope before legal signs off.

I'll confirm availability for a quick security call (Sara is CC'd and will DM availability). Procurement will attempt to share initial redlines by Friday.

Also attaching our vendor compliance checklist for reference: capsecure-security-reqs.pdf (attached).

Thanks,
Mike

Soojin — looping you in after a productive discovery with CapSecure (notes above). Procurement will push redlines but the immediate asks from security/compliance are: SOC2 Type II (controls mapping), 3+ year audit log retention with export, DPA redlines, and pen-test scoping/recency.

Can you: 
- Confirm whether we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 readout + controls mapping doc tomorrow.
- Prepare a redacted sample audit log (CSV) that demonstrates event fields and retention timestamps we can share with CapSecure.
- Suggest a pen-test timeline & a short scoping doc we can attach (they prefer independent reports within 12 months; if not available, we should propose co-scoped test timeline).

Priority: procurement indicated they want DPA language before legal moves forward. Ben — please keep procurement in your orbit and advise on typical commercial concessions for retention extensions.

Quoted: Mike's reply with details + attachment.

Thanks — appreciate a rapid turnaround on the artifacts.

Ava / Ben / Mike / Sara — thanks for the summary.

Short answer: we can meet the asks, and below is what I'll deliver and a proposed timeline.

Deliverables (what I'll provide):
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (attached) — a concise controls mapping and what artifacts we can share redacted. We cannot share customer-identifying sections of a third-party audit report without an NDA bump, but we can provide auditor name, report period, and control narratives for in-scope controls.
- audit-log-sample.csv (attached) — redacted sample export showing event_type, timestamp, user_id (hashed), request_id, model_id, and retention metadata. This mirrors the export format used by our retention APIs.
- DPA-template.docx (attached) — our standard DPA. If CapSecure sends redlines, we will route to legal for a 48–72 hour initial review.
- pen-test-scope.pdf (attached) — suggested scope and timeline. If they require an independent report within 12 months and we don't have one on file, propose co-scoped independent testing within 6–8 weeks; otherwise we can share the most recent internal assessment and remediation notes.

Security scoping call: I'm available Thu 12/3 09:00–11:00 PT or Fri 12/4 14:00–16:00 PT. Please pick a slot.

Notes on retention: our platform supports configurable retention policies; for audit logs we currently support up to 5 years retention in our hosted product with export hooks. For customers that require on-prem or private deployments for longer immutable archives, we recommend Private deployment + KMS-managed storage; we can align with CapSecure's preferred storage and export cadence during the scoping call.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll send the four artifacts attached to this thread immediately.
2) Schedule the security scoping call — Ava, can you coordinate times from Mike / Sara?
3) Procurement to share DPA redlines; legal review ETA 48–72 hours after redlines are received.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; audit-log-sample.csv; DPA-template.docx; pen-test-scope.pdf

Let me know if you want a separate encrypted transfer for the SOC artifacts.
